dogecoin.text: @dlaregbtc @Ryan0Walker @litecoin @dogecoin @Vertcoin Core devs are there to filter proposed code changes  under the principle of Do No Damage. They are not there to drive the direction of Bitcoin. Satoshi programed the 1mb block limit, not Core devs.
@dlaregbtc @Ryan0Walker @litecoin @dogecoin @Vertcoin You have that wrong. Core devs are not 'leadership'. But if that is what you're into then open source is not a good fit.
